text:
Jordan-Sales: Hey team — Orion Health is seeing a big queue bump in eu-west-1 for their demo next Tue. 95% of requests are queueing, demo needs 2x throughput. Can we get a temporary quota override or burst capacity for that customer?
anna-support: Thanks, Jordan. Can you confirm org id, workspace, model family, and expected peak RPS? Also is this hosted or dedicated?
Jordan-Sales: Org: orion-health-prod, workspace: orion-poc, model: redwood-3b-quant, hosted. Peak target ~120 RPS sustained for 2 hours during demo, current healthy baseline ~30 RPS.
mike-sre: Noted. We're seeing admission control kicking in for eu-west-1 since 08:40 UTC. Autoscaler couldn't keep up due to instance preemptions + a slow rolling update earlier. Current cluster GPU utilization ~92%. Backpressure policy is rejecting / queueing beyond 80% threshold.
deploy-bot: [ALERT] capacity-alert eu-west-1: node-pool-inference-3 down (3/8 nodes) — autoscaler triggered scale-up request (req id 0x9f3b).
anna-support: @mike-sre can you share the queue logs and the current quota limits for orion-health? We need to scope the override.
mike-sre: Pasting quick logs: ```
[08:38:12] admit: enqueued request org=orion-health size=1024 tokens model=redwood-3b-quant
[08:38:15] admission: reject -> queue_limit reached (active=480 queued=120)
[08:39:01] autoscaler: scaleup request pending (cloud quota throttle)
```
Quota for orion-health: concurrent_slots=200, rps_limit=40, burst_limit=80. They keep hitting the rps_limit due to many concurrent small chats.
lucy-platform: Cloud provider also throttling new instance creation in eu-west-1 for this project due to burst-rate cap. Short term we can either: 1) bump per-org concurrent_slots/rps in our admission layer; 2) route overflow to another region (eu-north or eu-central); 3) create temporary Dedicated reservation. Option 1 is fastest.
Jordan-Sales: Routing regions is messy for the demo. Can we do option 1 for a 3-hour window tomorrow? Sales is ok to cover extra cost.
rachel-finance: Quick heads up — estimated incremental infra cost for 3 hours at +100% capacity ~ $720 (GPUs + network). Confirm before approving if you want billing to charge the customer's card.
anna-support: Ok, to proceed I need an explicit approval from sales + signoff on cost. Jordan, confirm you want a temporary increase: concurrent_slots +100 (to 400), rps_limit -> 120, for window 2026-11-03 09:00-12:00 UTC.
Jordan-Sales: Approved. Charge to Orion Health P-Card on file.
mike-sre: Will apply admission overrides and a soft cap so rollback is simple. Patch I'll run: ```
# increase per-org limits
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/limits/override -d '{"org":"orion-health-prod","concurrent":400,"rps":120,"expires":"2026-11-03T12:00:00Z"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer bot-token'
```
anna-support: I'll create the support ticket and note the escalation. tagging eng-platform to monitor autoscaler during window.
lucy-platform: I'll keep a watch. If autoscaler still can't provision, we'll failover to eu-central and enable traffic split. Also will request provider soft quota increase (cloud ticket) as a follow-up.
deploy-bot: [INFO] quota-override applied for orion-health-prod by mike-sre, id=ovr-20261103-001, expires=2026-11-03T12:00:00Z
mike-sre: Override in place. Please monitor latency and queue depth. If queue > 100 for >5m, we'll engage region failover.
Jordan-Sales: Huge — thanks team. Can we get a short postmortem after demo so we can propose a Dedicated for them?
anna-support: Yep — will file a postmortem and recommend either a reserved Dedicated pool or traffic-based autoscaling tuning. Closing this thread once postmortem is posted. :thumbsup:
